# OmniVoice TTS + HyperFrames Render

> Two independent HTTP services in one repository. `tts/` synthesizes speech in one of 12 fixed voices. `render/` renders a HyperFrames project stored in S3 to an mp4 through an asynchronous job. Both return public file URLs (S3 or S3-compatible storage), never file bytes.

No API key is needed by default. A deployment may set `API_KEY`, and then every endpoint except `GET /health` expects the `X-API-Key` header. Bodies are JSON.

## Base URLs
- TTS (public deployment on Modal, GPU, scales to zero; the first request after idle takes about 20 to 30 seconds): `https://jamesngdev--omnivoice-tts-web.us-east.modal.run`
- Render: no public deployment yet. Run `render/` yourself and use its URL.

## Start here
- [Text to speech](docs/llms/tts.md): `POST /tts`, `GET /voices`, `GET /health`, auth, caching, errors
- [Video render](docs/llms/render.md): `POST /render`, `GET /jobs/{job_id}`, input folder forms, job states, limits, S3 layout and bucket policy

## API
- [POST /tts](docs/llms/tts.md#post-tts): synthesize text to wav or mp3
- [GET /voices](docs/llms/tts.md#get-voices): list voices, optional filters
- [GET /health](docs/llms/tts.md#get-health): liveness (both services)
- [POST /render](docs/llms/render.md#post-render): queue a render job (202)
- [GET /jobs/{job_id}](docs/llms/render.md#get-jobsjobid): poll job status and result URL

## Reference
- [Authentication and errors](docs/llms/tts.md#authentication): optional key, 401, 404, 413, 422 meanings
- [S3 layout and bucket policy](docs/llms/render.md#s3-layout-and-bucket-policy): which prefixes must be public
- [Limits](docs/llms/render.md#limits): queue size, timeout, download caps

## Repository layout
- `tts/`: TTS service (FastAPI, OmniVoice, Dockerfile, Modal deployment); details in `tts/README.md`
- `render/`: render service (FastAPI, HyperFrames CLI, Dockerfile); details in `render/README.md`
